description: This file contains a PHP unit test class `FormatWithCompetencyTest` which tests the functionality of the `FormatWithCompetency` class within the OrangeHRM Maintenance plugin. It sets up test data and checks that the `getFormattedValue()` method returns expected strings for given input values.

classes.name: FormatWithCompetencyTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the FormatWithCompetency class.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by loading fixture data and initializing the FormatWithCompetency instance.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Tests that the getFormattedValue method returns the correct formatted string for given competency values.
